hook_targets.side_effects: Replaces a recompiled guest function with a host C++ implementation. Used by 323 address-based binds across the .inc parts.
Fails silently if the name is absent from PS2_STUB_LIST/PS2_SYSCALL_LIST; the 126 unresolved startup entries are exactly these SDK/debug names, not gameplay overrides.
Filters by guest ELF name/entry/CRC32; requires /WHOLEARCHIVE on the ps2_runtime static lib, which the build applies.
Written once per guest frame in f29_mgendframe_probe; read by GS-side censuses for windowing. Was never written before the 2026-09-25 merge.

hook_targets.injection_type: Per-thread CPU capture at thread entry (G735, ported from Red-tv141/DC2-PS2RECOMP)
hook_targets.side_effects: DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentThread) into a 3-slot table (0=G713 exec, 1=VU1/MTVU worker, 2=GS parse worker). Called once from each worker entry; read-only for diagnostics; ~2 reads/second from the EE frame boundary.

Busy/idle accumulators are gated on DC2_G182_EE_STAT (the board flag), so shipping runs pay one predicted branch per drain cycle and no clock reads. CPU column comes from GetThreadTimes on the duplicated exec-thread handle; 0 means no column.

reads: ISO image via synthetic sector mount (DC2_ISO_PATH)

invariants: Override descriptors match on SCUS_972.13 + entry + CRC32; a mismatched ELF silently yields 0 applied overrides.
registerFunction never validates the address against the recompiled function table.
G599: g_dc2ScriptFrame.store() must run unconditionally once per guest frame in f29_mgendframe_probe or all script-clock-keyed probes miswindow.

G738: every per-window column must be PRIMED from the first non-zero read of its cumulative counter, not from zero; worker threads start lazily and an unprimed delta charges the thread's whole accumulated time to one window.

Diagnostic-only: the ported G734/G735/G738/G742 blocks must never be on a behaviour path. All accumulation is gated on DC2_G182_EE_STAT; with the flag unset the added cost is one predicted branch per drain cycle.

Still deferred from the Red-tv141 G721-G745 set: G739 (needs its G646-table ballast/oracle counters), G745 (needs the G726 kick spin, which this lineage does not have), and the G736/G737 route/GL censuses. Do not port them piecemeal.
